rule_descriptions.F_HOST_RECEIPT_GATE: Four required F-host receipts must exist before final-ready or business-row promotion.
rule_descriptions.CONTINUATION_KEY_GATE: Continuation key must remain unchanged across recovery and research increments.
rule_descriptions.SINGLE_RUNNER_GATE: No second runner, task or takeover is permitted while canonical recovery is unresolved.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Source candidate IDs must remain contiguous and non-duplicated.
rule_descriptions.OPERATION_SEQUENCE_GATE: Operation IDs must remain contiguous and non-duplicated.
rule_descriptions.EXAMPLE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Prepared example IDs must remain unique; repairs 071 and 074 remain preserved.
rule_descriptions.GROUND_TRUTH_ROLE: EA ground-truth points validate survey QC; they are not parcel terrain samples.
rule_descriptions.GROUND_TRUTH_POINT_ACCURACY: Ground-truth point accuracy and LiDAR survey RMSE are separate uncertainty layers.
rule_descriptions.LIDAR_ABSOLUTE_RMSE: EA absolute vertical RMSE threshold is not a parcel confidence interval.
rule_descriptions.LIDAR_RELATIVE_ERROR: EA relative/random error is distinct from absolute datum error.
rule_descriptions.POINT_DENSITY_ROLE: Point-cloud density is not raster resolution.
rule_descriptions.DTM_DENSITY_VEGETATION: DTM ground-return density under vegetation is not assumed from DSM point density.
rule_descriptions.COMPOSITE_SURVEY_ID: Composite contributing survey identity requires metadata-index matching.
rule_descriptions.COMPOSITE_RESAMPLING: Bilinear resampling must remain explicit and must not be called a native observation.
rule_descriptions.WMS_WCS_ROLE: WMS portrayal is excluded from numeric sampling; WCS/raster access is required.
rule_descriptions.DTM_DSM_ROLE: DSM/first-return surface models are excluded from primary bare-earth extrema.
rule_descriptions.TITLE_PLAN_GENERAL_EXTENT: Title-plan red edging/general extent is not an exact legal boundary.
rule_descriptions.GENERAL_BOUNDARY_ZONE: General-boundary red lines carry positional uncertainty and are not exact legal geometry.
rule_descriptions.BOUNDARY_AGREEMENT_ROLE: Recorded boundary agreement is not automatically a section-60 determined boundary.
rule_descriptions.DETERMINED_BOUNDARY_EVIDENCE: Exact legal-boundary claims require determined-boundary evidence.
rule_descriptions.BOUNDARY_MEASURE_TOLERANCE: HMLR +/-10mm plan measurement tolerance is horizontal legal-survey evidence, not LiDAR vertical RMSE.
rule_descriptions.BOUNDARY_COORD_ABS_TOL: HMLR +/-300mm National Grid absolute tolerance is legal-plan positioning evidence, not terrain accuracy.
rule_descriptions.TERRAIN5_CELL_MEAN: OS Terrain 5 grid values are means across 5m pixels and remain secondary.
rule_descriptions.TERRAIN5_PIXEL_CENTER: Terrain 5 ASCII sample position is pixel-centre; storage convention is not accuracy.
rule_descriptions.TERRAIN5_STORAGE_PRECISION: 0.01m stored precision does not imply 0.01m vertical accuracy.
rule_descriptions.TERRAIN5_METADATA_VERSION: Tile version number records publication lineage, not acquisition time.
rule_descriptions.TERRAIN5_LINEAGE_TEXT: Created/revised/verified tile lineage is contextual, not primary parcel measurement.
rule_descriptions.CRS_HORIZONTAL_VERTICAL: Horizontal CRS and vertical datum must be tracked separately.
rule_descriptions.OSGM15_ROLE: Geoid-model transformation uncertainty is separate from LiDAR measurement RMSE.
rule_descriptions.OSTN15_ROLE: Horizontal datum transformation must not be counted as vertical accuracy.
rule_descriptions.GEOTIFF_PIXEL_TYPE: PixelIsArea and PixelIsPoint use different raster-space reference conventions and must not be conflated.
rule_descriptions.GEOTIFF_GEOREFERENCE: GeoTIFF georeference tags establish spatial referencing, not terrain truth.
rule_descriptions.REFERENCEABLE_GRID_ROLE: Referenceable-grid transformations must not be assumed equivalent to a rectified regular grid.
rule_descriptions.CIS_DOMAIN_RANGE: Coverage domain locations and range values must map consistently.
rule_descriptions.COVERAGEJSON_FORMAT_ROLE: CoverageJSON is an encoding/representation contract, not terrain authority.
rule_descriptions.EDR_ENCODING_ROLE: OGC API EDR content negotiation and response encoding are separate from numeric source authority.
rule_descriptions.WCS_CRS_OUTPUT_ROLE: WCS output-CRS transformation must be explicit and is not native-grid evidence.
rule_descriptions.WCS_RANGE_SUBSETTING_ROLE: WCS range-component selection is distinct from spatial sampling, scaling and interpolation.
rule_descriptions.WCS_SCALING_ROLE: Scaled WCS output is derived and must not be called native resolution.
rule_descriptions.WCS_INTERPOLATION_ROLE: Interpolation must be explicit when applied and must not be hidden as native sampling.
rule_descriptions.WCS_BINDING_ROLE: KVP/XML/SOAP bindings are transport only and do not change numeric semantics.
rule_descriptions.SURVEY_DATE_ROLE: Publication/update date must not be substituted for actual acquisition date.
rule_descriptions.SURVEY_TRANSFORM_ROLE: Survey-specific transform/geoid metadata is required for historical lineage comparisons.
rule_descriptions.PIXEL_SELECTION_ROLE: Pixel-center inclusion rule must remain explicit and reproducible.
rule_descriptions.POLYGON_ROLE: Canonical HMLR polygon and legal-boundary status must not be conflated.
rule_descriptions.ABSENCE_NOT_ZERO: Missing/no-data/unknown lineage must not be converted to numeric zero.
rule_descriptions.UNKNOWN_FAIL_CLOSED: Unresolved parcel-specific survey identity remains UNKNOWN rather than inferred.
rule_descriptions.NUMERIC_PRESERVATION: Existing measured 1m/2m parcel values must not change during source-contract QA.
rule_descriptions.RESULT_CONFIDENCE_ROLE: Repository 96% result confidence is workflow confidence, not a universal statistical guarantee.
rule_descriptions.BUSINESS_ROW_GUARD: Business rows remain zero until canonical recovery acceptance completes.
rule_descriptions.FINAL_READY_GUARD: final_ready remains false while any required F-host receipt is missing.
rule_descriptions.WEB_OVERLAY_ROLE: Repo overlay exposes QA rows but is not equivalent to live Chromium acceptance.
rule_descriptions.MAIN_MANIFEST_CONCURRENCY: Shared main manifest is not rewritten under concurrent branch activity.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_PROMOTION_GATE: Only official, scoped evidence can be promoted; semantic overreach fails closed.
rule_descriptions.CURRENTNESS_GATE: Currentness/version history supports source selection but does not create numeric accuracy.
rule_descriptions.FORMAT_NOT_ACCURACY: GeoTIFF/GeoPackage/JSON/XML format choice does not increase source RMSE quality.
rule_descriptions.PROCESSING_NOT_NATIVE: Server-side processing output must be labelled derived unless native retrieval is proven.
